title: Learning: Played Back
text: Someone recorded one of Alex's sign-ins last week and sends it again today.

cards.label: Issue a new random challenge for this attempt
Reuse last week's challenge: it worked then
cards.why: If the challenge repeats, so can the answer. A recorded response would sign the attacker in.

cards.label: Confirm with Alex and sign this challenge
Sign a batch of future challenges now, to save time
cards.why: Signatures made in advance can be stolen and used later. Each one answers a challenge that exists now.

cards.label: Reject the sign-in
cards.why: Nothing was wrong with it. Refusing something legitimate without looking is its own failure: check, then act.

fields.label: challenge signed
fields.value: the one issued four seconds ago
fields.check: Compare the signed challenge with the one you issued
fields.ok: It is the challenge issued for this attempt.

intrusion.detail: This response answers a challenge from last week.
intrusion.why: A genuine signature, recorded and played back. The fresh challenge is what makes last week's answer worthless.
intrusion.reveal: The response was a recording from last week, replayed.

teaches: A challenge is used once. That is all it takes to defeat a recording.
The website must compare the signed challenge with the one it issued, not just verify the signature.
